title: Can pyramid
hints: You need a running total that starts at 0, and a loop that visits every row number from 1 to `n`.
`for (int row = 1; row <= n; row++)` visits 1, 2, …, n. Add `row` to your total each time round. If `n` is 0 or negative, the loop simply never runs.
`int total = 0; for (int row = 1; row <= n; row++) { total += row; } return total;`
